messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: surge in 5xx and gateway timeouts observed for inference-gateway in prod (us-west-2) starting ~10:54 UTC. p95 jumped from 120ms -> 1.8s, p99 -> 4.6s. Error rate spike to ~6.3% 5xx. Auto-notify paging oncall.
Samir (oncall): I’m paged, looking. Any deploys in the last 30m?
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: inference-gateway v2026.3.15-rc4 -> v2026.3.15. Started 10:47 UTC, finished 10:52 UTC. Canary passed.
Elaine (SRE): seeing a spike in upstream 504s from runtime nodes and a lot of connection reset by peer in gateway logs. Also seeing a burst of long tail token generation requests (seq > 1024).
Maya (runtime): rolling change in the runtime that landed in this deploy enabled a new packing/seqpad optimization. We saw higher KV cache churn in canary logs but passed perf tests. Investigating whether seqpad is evicting KV caches prematurely.
Jack (infra): autoscale got a small bump but not enough to cover surge. Can we route traffic to dedicated pool fallback or throttle requests?
Samir (oncall): immediate mitigation: (1) disable seqpad flag in gateway (2) flip gateway circuit to fallback model variant (lighter quantized) (3) throttle client burst via rate-limiter. Which is fastest?
Maya (runtime): fastest is feature flag flip. I can disable seqpad via env toggle on gateway config: /ops/flags/seqpad=false — takes ~15s to propagate per pod.
Elaine (SRE): while Maia flips flag, let's prepare rollback. If errors don't drop within 5m after flag flip, rollback to previous revision. Rollback command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-gateway -n prod`.
Jack (infra): routing to dedicated fallback: `infractl route set inference-gateway --pool dedicated-fallback --weight 100 --region us-west-2` — will take ~30s to warm. I can do that after flag flip if needed.
Maya (runtime): seqpad flag flipped. confirming rollout to pods: 3/5 pods restarted so far.
Samir (oncall): monitoring p95/p99 now. pushing alert silence to avoid noise.
Elaine (SRE): within 60s p95 fell from 1.8s -> 420ms, p99 4.6s -> 1.1s, error rate down to 1.8%. Good signal. Keep watching for 3m.
Alex (product): any customer impact? We have a handful of large customers calling the API at this hour, possible degraded responses. Notified account ops to prepare messaging if rollback required.
deploy-bot: Canary logs show repeated KV cache miss spikes correlated with large-seq calls; seqpad was over-aggressive for sequences >512 with our current KV eviction heuristics.
Samir (oncall): ok still trending down but tail not fully recovered. Leave flag off. Do we still need rollback? Not yet.
Elaine (SRE): agree. Next steps: Open a P1 ticket to track RCA, include linking logs and sampling traces. Assign to Maya and runtime team for root cause and revert of seqpad until heuristics improved.
Maya (runtime): creating jira INF-4621. Will run targeted perf tests with larger seq distributions and adjust eviction thresholds. Also will add a canary that simulates high-seq traffic.
Jack (infra): I've queued an automated route fallback just in case: will only switch if error rate >3% for 5m. Currently in standby.
Alex (product): Customer ops: sent a heads-up to top-20 customers with observed degradation window 10:47–10:55 UTC, handful of requests retried automatically. Asking for any confirmed user-facing errors.
Samir (oncall): logging snippets attached for postmortem: ```
gateway ERROR: upstream timeout id=abc123 dur=10010ms status=504 path=/v1/generate
runtime WARN: kvcache_evict key=node42 seq=768 reason=pressure
runtime INFO: sequence_pad_applied seq=768 bytes_padded=256
```
Elaine (SRE): reactions: :thumbsup: to the quick flag flip. We probably saved a rollback. Note to oncall: if p99 doesn’t get <800ms in 10m, enact rollback.
Maya (runtime): will add fallback kernel selection to avoid seqpad on large sequences and publish a config patch. Patching timeline: 24–48h for full fix + patch for canary policy.
Samir (oncall): Thanks team. I'll do the follow-up timeline and handoff to next oncall. Creating incident channel and scheduling a 1hr follow-up postmortem at 14:00 UTC.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-01, severity: high, initial mitigation: seqpad flag off, standby route fallback. Notify: #incidents, #sre, #runtime.
Elaine (SRE): postmortem notes to include: why canary didn't surface this seq distribution, gap in perf test coverage, and recovery steps (flag flip, fallback route). Also verify alert thresholds and silence logic.
Samir (oncall): handing off to Maya for RCA, I'm logging out of pager but reachable if needed. Closing thread for live mitigation, keeping incident channel open for postmortem and customer comms.
summary: Live mitigation for post-deploy timeout regression: feature-flag flip prevented rollback; KV cache churn from new seqpad optimization caused p95/p99 spike; follow-up Jira and incident created.
